key.name: max-width
key.description: The maximum width in pixels before text gets truncated.

key.name: hide-next-when-active
key.summary: Hide next event when one is ongoing
key.description: If true, only shows the current active event and hides upcoming ones.

key.name: done-text
key.summary: Text to display when no events remain
key.description: The string displayed when the calendar is clear.

key.name: progress-green-color
key.summary: Progress color with at least 60 minutes remaining
key.description: A muted pastel green used when an event is not imminent.

key.name: progress-orange-color
key.summary: Progress color with 10 to 59 minutes remaining
key.description: A muted pastel orange used as an event approaches.

key.name: progress-red-color
key.summary: Progress color with less than 10 minutes remaining
key.description: A muted pastel red used immediately before an event.

key.name: progress-orange-threshold
key.description: The bar becomes orange below this number of minutes.

key.name: progress-red-threshold
key.description: The bar becomes red below this number of minutes.

key.name: excluded-keywords
key.description: Comma-separated list of words. Events containing these will be ignored.

key.name: enable-early-completion
key.description: Allows dismissing an active event before its scheduled end time.
